description.p: Radix is a desktop calculator with a history-centric workflow: every evaluated equation becomes a history row whose results re-render live when the number format, grouping or number base changes.

It offers Basic, Advanced, Financial, Programming, Keyboard and Conversion modes; arbitrary-precision arithmetic with exact rational results; trigonometry with configurable angle units; bitwise operations with a selectable word size; live unit and currency conversion; and four result formats (Automatic, Fixed, Scientific, Engineering).
Initial independent implementation of the Radix behavioral specification.
